# 1 Enoch Chapter 35 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**35:1** And after that I saw the other portals in the west at the ends of the great earth: three portals of heaven open there in the same manner as the former portals in the north.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). Chapter 35 is a single verse — the briefest chapter in 1 Enoch — describing the western portals by analogy with the northern ones (ch. 34). The tripartite portal structure (one beneficent, two harmful) is implied for the west as it was stated for the north.*
